task: Write a handover checklist for the person covering the renewals pipeline. The leave start date and length are needed so the cover period can be planned.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Nadia Aguilar
Subject: Before I leave

I start parental leave on 3 February and I am away for five months. The baby is due in late January so my start date could move by a week or two. Please also tell the new team lead that Dare to Lead by Brené Brown is how I run feedback sessions.
